legacyClosures.gate: Eclipse Wing turn end: ECLIPSE_COUNTER_TARGET.get(holder)?.isFainted() === true, a private per-Pokemon memory filled by tryEclipseWing with the foe my counter-strike aimed at; needs the atom for 'the foe I struck back at has fainted' (R-B13-35)

instances.summary: At the end of the turn, if the foe my counter-strike aimed at has fainted, I lose all my remaining HP and faint too.
While I have this, once per wave a hit that would knock me out from full HP leaves me at 1 HP and I answer with a 120 power Dark special move against the attacker.

legacyClosures.gate: Final Season entry: VOLUNTARY_ENTRY.has(holder), a private set filled by markGenuineVoluntaryEntry when the switch was a deliberate party command; needs the atom entry.voluntary-switch-in (R-B13-1)

instances.summary: When I switch in on purpose, every foe gets the effect "Move last (Quash-like)" for 2 turns (it moves last in its priority group), and my end-of-turn weather effect is made ready.

legacyClosures.gate: Final Season fog: FINAL_SEASON_PENDING_FOG.has(holder), a private set filled by the entry effect (a flag set by the switch-in effect); needs the atom time.armed (R-B13-2)

instances.summary: At the end of a turn, if my switch-in effect happened this turn, the weather becomes "Eerie Fog" for 5 turns, and I remember it as my own weather.
While the Eerie Fog on the field is the one I set, my Dark and Flying moves have 1.3 times their power. Example: a 100 power Dark move becomes 130.

legacyClosures.gate: Foul Harvest: damage > 0, hitResult < NO_EFFECT and 'my last move record is new' (a per-Pokemon memory of the last counted move); needs hit.dealt-damage, hit.not-blocked and time.new-move-of-mine (R-B13-3, R-B13-4, R-B13-5)

instances.summary: When my damaging move hits, the foe's last-used move (or a random one) loses 1 PP and I store a charge, up to 3. Stored charges power up my draining moves.
When I enter the battle, any charges I had stored are lost and my counter starts again from 0.
Sound-based moves do 0.5x damage to me. Example: a sound move that would deal 100 damage deals 50.

legacyClosures.gate: Porous charge: damage > 0, hitResult < NO_EFFECT and 'the foe's last move record is not the one already counted' (a per-Pokemon memory); needs hit.dealt-damage, hit.not-blocked and time.new-move-of-foe (R-B13-3, R-B13-4, R-B13-6)

instances.summary: When a foe's move damages me, I store 1 charge, up to 3. A multi-hit move counts once. My next Ground move spends the stored charges for extra power.
My Ground move gains 25% power per stored charge and all charges are spent. Example: 2 charges turn 100 power into 150.
At the end of the turn, if an entry hazard is on my side, one hazard loses 1 layer (or disappears) and my Defense and Sp. Def rise by 1 stage.
When I remove an entry hazard from my side, a Bloom grows on the foes' side. At the end of each turn it drains 1/16 of each foe's max HP and heals my side by the total.
While my other face is out, my damaging moves have 1.5 times their power, and Electric or Dark moves a further 1.4 times.

legacyClosures.gate: Two-Faced recoil: TWO_FACED_ACTIVE_TURN[holder] === 'wave:turn', a private per-Pokemon memory set when the other face comes out; needs the atom time.armed-this-turn (R-B13-22)

instances.summary: While my other face is out, each damaging move I land costs me 15% of my max HP, once per move. It never takes me below 1 HP.

legacyClosures.gate: Skyhook: SKYHOOK_TURN.get(holder) !== 'wave:turn', i.e. I have not pivoted out yet this turn (a private per-Pokemon memory that apply writes); needs the atom time.not-yet-this-turn (R-B13-17)

instances.summary: After my damaging move hurts the target I switch out, once per turn (on the last hit of a multi-hit move). My replacement has a 20% chance to enter with +1 Speed.
When I enter the battle, the count of boosts I gained from resisted hits is set back to 0, so I can gain them again.
After a damaging hit that my typing resists (but does not block), I gain 1 stage of Defense if it was physical, else Sp. Def. At most 2 times per switch-in, once per foe move.

legacyClosures.gate: Living Chrome: SHAPE_MEMORY[holder] exists, was made this wave and this turn, and (state.flat or its types include the attacker's move type); a private per-Pokemon memory written by recordLivingChromeTransformation; needs the atom for 'I hold a shape memory from this turn that covers the attacker's move type' (R-B13-50)

instances.summary: For one turn after I change shape, damage from a type I just left is multiplied by 0.5 (0.75 for all types after leaving the base form). 0.5 = half damage.
Contact moves used against me have their accuracy multiplied by 0.7. Example: 0.7 turns a 100% move into 70%. Moves that never miss are not changed.
My move gains 10% power for every weight class I am above the target, up to 5 classes. Example: 3 classes above at 10% turn 100 power into 130.
After my Heavy Slam, Heat Crash or punching move damages the target, its Defense changes by -1 stage. Works once per turn.
After my punching move hurts the target, the same move hits again as a Ghost-type echo at 30% power (50% if I am Ghost type). It ignores the target's Defense boosts.
When my arrow or pulse move damages a foe, that foe becomes my mark. Only one foe is marked at a time, and the mark ends when either of us leaves the field.
While the game decides if a hit is a critical hit, my pulse moves always crit the foe I marked, as long as it is on the field.
While I have this, my pulse moves against the foe I marked are calculated against whichever of its Defense and Sp. Def is lower.

legacyClosures.gate: Boot Hill: opponent.isFainted(), i.e. the target was knocked out by this hit; no library atom reads whether a Pokemon has fainted; needs the atom mon.fainted{who} (R-B13-44)

instances.summary: When my damaging move knocks the target out, a one-use marker is planted on the foe's side. The next foe that enters takes 1/8 of its max HP as damage and loses 1 Speed stage.
When I enter the battle, I note the current turn. Another part of the ability uses that note to stay quiet until the next turn.

legacyClosures.gate: Ring General trap: my HP is above half (rounded whole percents) and I did not come in this turn (a private per-Pokemon memory) and the foe is not a Ghost; needs the atoms hp.above-rounded (R-B13-31) and time.entered-this-turn (R-B13-30), the Ghost part is mon.has-type

instances.summary: While my HP is above half and I did not come in this turn, foes cannot switch out or run away. Ghost types and Pokemon with Run Away still get away.
When I enter the battle, the damaging move I remembered from before is wiped, so the first move I use has nothing to echo.
After my damaging move hurts the target, my previous different damaging move is replayed against it at 40% of its power. Example: a 100 power move echoes as 40.
When I enter the battle, the two moves I had recorded and my combo count are wiped, so I start recording a new pattern.

legacyClosures.gate: Setlist power: setlistNextLevel(holder, move) > 0, i.e. the pattern holds two moves and this is the one expected next (a private per-Pokemon state machine); needs the atom time.expected-move (R-B13-25)

instances.summary: Once I have used two different moves, the one my pattern expects next gains 20% power per step, up to 2 steps. Example: 20% turns 100 power into 120, then 140.

legacyClosures.gate: Setlist accuracy: setlistNextLevel(holder, move) > 0, i.e. the pattern holds two moves and this is the one expected next (a private per-Pokemon state machine); needs the atom time.expected-move (R-B13-25)

instances.summary: Once I have used two different moves, the one my pattern expects next gains 10% accuracy per step, up to 2 steps. Example: 10% turns 80 accuracy into 88, then 96.
My special moves gain 5% power for every healthy teammate waiting in the back, up to 5. Example: 3 waiting at 5% turns 100 power into 115.

legacyClosures.gate: Fan Favorite accuracy: livingBenchCount(holder) > 0, i.e. a party member of my side that is neither fainted nor on the field; needs the atom party.bench-count (R-B13-29)

instances.summary: My moves gain 5% accuracy for every healthy teammate waiting in the back, up to 5. Example: 2 waiting at 5% turns 80 accuracy into 88.

legacyClosures.gate: Reduction power: REDUCTION_ACTIVE.get(holder) holds this very move and this turn's key, i.e. prepareReductionMove consumed the field for this move (a private per-Pokemon memory written by an engine call by name); needs the atom for 'the field was consumed for this move' (R-B13-48)

instances.summary: While the game calculates a move's power, the move that just used up the weather or terrain has 1.5 times its power. Example: 100 power becomes 150.
When I enter the battle after losing a type earlier, I come in with the shorter type list I had left instead of my full types.

legacyClosures.gate: Center of Attention spread reduction: move.isMultiTarget(), i.e. the move's target kind is one of ALL_OTHERS, ALL_NEAR_OTHERS, ALL_NEAR_ENEMIES, ALL_ENEMIES, USER_AND_ALLIES, ALL, USER_SIDE, ENEMY_SIDE, BOTH_SIDES; move.target-kind groups these differently (PARTY, USER, NEAR_ALLY, ALLY and USER_OR_NEAR_ALLY would match too); needs the atom move.hits-several-targets (R-B13-39)

instances.summary: While the game calculates the damage I take, spread moves are multiplied by 0.75. Example: 0.75 = takes a quarter less, even when only one target is left.
When a foe damages one of my allies instead of me, that foe's Sp. Atk changes by -1 stage after the move. It works once per move the foe used.
